children: is poised to break a resistance at $91.22 per barrel and rise toward the next resistance at $92.59.

These resistances are identified respectively as the 61.8% and the 76.4% retracements of the downtrend from $94.81. The resistance at $91.22 only triggered a shallow correction, which has been almost reversed.

The reversal signals a steady uptrend from $85.43, which may extend further. A projection analysis of the rise from $86.22 reveals lower resistance at $91.96, a break above it could confirm the target of $92.59.
Key support is at $90.12, only a break below it could suggest a reversal of the uptrend from $85.43. On the daily chart, the contract has broken a resistance at $90.41.
The break opened the way toward the $94.18-$97.95 range.
